messages:
emma_r: Quick checklist thread — finalizing the GA acceptance rubric for Predict. Key buckets: SLA language, docs completeness, monitoring SLIs, support coverage, pricing examples. Please call out any fatal gaps. Need final ack by EOD. @maria_g @ben_w @tara_l

maria_g: SLA update: added exception windows and clarified incident notification timeline (15m). Still waiting on legal to approve trial-credit and refund wording. Link: https://staging.docs.redwood/predict/sla-rubric

ben_w: Docs: Quickstart + error handling + quota blurb almost done. Remaining: short example for "graceful degradation" (how we fallback to smaller/quantized model). Can mark streaming as preview.

tara_l: Support: I'll take primary for the first 48h. Need one PST-evening backup; @ben_w can you take evenings Wed-Fri for week1? Also want a concise runbook for degraded-model fallback (steps + escalation).

ben_w: I can cover Wed-Fri 18:00-22:00 PT week1. I'll draft runbook steps and add the automated rollback trigger.

ops-bot: Preflight summary: infra capacity OK (headroom verified). Canary slot reserved: 2024-07-15T16:00Z. CI smoke scheduled every 5m.

emma_r: Monitoring: propose SLIs: p95 latency, p99 latency, error-rate(5xx+4xx), and a model-quality SLI (sample prompts matched to baseline). Alerting thresholds: p99 > 400ms OR error-rate > 0.75% over 10m → page oncall + evaluate rollback.

maria_g: Pricing: examples use per-1k-token meter. Need short FAQ blurb describing overages and quota behaviour. I'll coordinate wording with billing.

ben_w: Docs blurb draft: "If your organization exceeds quota, requests return 429 and X-Quota-Remaining/X-Quota-Reset headers. Contact support/sales to increase quota." Will land in staging tonight.

tara_l: Runbook note: degraded-model fallback = switch routing to quantized-v2, post summary to #incidents, create incident, escalate to infra on-call if error persists > 15m. Need CI test for automated switch.

ops-bot: Automated fallback implemented in staging runbooks (manual approval required to revert). Smoke test snippet for CI: ```bash
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/predict -d '{"input":"smoke"}' | jq '.status'``` asserts "ok" + HTTP 200.

emma_r: Final owners: emma_r (launch lead), maria_g (SLA/docs/legal), ben_w (docs/ci/runbooks), tara_l (support/oncall). Legal is the remaining dependency — if legal clears trial/refund language by EOD we go green and schedule canary per ops-bot.

maria_g: I've pinged legal and product counsel. Will update here as soon as I have confirmation. If legal objects we'll delay GA by 24h.

emma_r: Thanks — leaving this open for legal ack. If no other blocks I'll send ship notice at 17:30 PT. :shipit:
